selection_rule: Every open-source tool found on PyPI or GitHub that generates mutants of Python source to assess a test suite; tools are benchmarked when they install and run on CPython 3.14 and generate mutants automatically. Excluded tools are listed with the observed reason.

pytest plugin installing the patched module, coverage-gated
regular-expression mutants as files, one test command per mutant
Rust driver, pytest plugin or subprocess backend
Rust driver, trampolines, pre-warmed forked pytest workers
in-memory AST schemata on a diff or explicit files
